items.period: Shang dynasty; oracle-bone script style (modern vector rendering of a Xiaoxuetang glyph identified as 42.F100, 甲2827 合27941)
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of a Shang oracle-script form of 年, showing the early graph associated with 禾 above 人.
items.alt: A monochrome vector rendering of an early 年 graph, with a grain-like upper element and a human-shaped lower element.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description identifies 年 specifically, cites the Xiaoxuetang record, and documents CC0/public-domain reuse. It illustrates the early pictorial account while remaining explicitly a modern redraw.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 for the Xiaoxuetang glyph image; Commons also states the vector representation is public domain. Modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The exact source description and direct image URL were verified, but the browser tool could not inspect or render the SVG because it rejected image/svg+xml. This is a candidate only; the harness must confirm downstream fetch and visual review. Xiaoxuetang character query was unavailable in this run.
